chunks: And ʿAlī ibn Riʾāb narrated from Abū Ḥamzah al-Thumālī, from Jābir ibn ʿAbdillāh al-Anṣārī, who said:

We were sitting with the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family. He said: We began discussing women and the superiority of some of them over others, so the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said: Shall I not inform you of the best of your women?

They said: Yes, O Messenger of Allah, then inform us. He said: Among the best of your women is the fertile, loving, modest, chaste one; honored among her family, humble with her husband; adorned for her husband, guarded from others; the one who listens to his speech and obeys his command; and when he is alone with her, she gives him what he desires from her, and she does not present herself to him in the manner of a man.

key_terms.السَّتِيرَةَ: one who is modest and concealing of herself
key_terms.الْحَصَانَ: one who guards herself and remains chaste
key_terms.الْعَفِيفَةَ: one who is chaste and morally restrained
key_terms.الْمُتَبَرِّجَةَ: one who displays adornment, here for her husband
key_terms.الْوَدُودَ: one who is loving and affectionate
key_terms.الْوَلُودَ: one who is fertile and able to bear children

ai.seo_question: What qualities does the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله describe as the best traits of women in marriage?
ai.summary: This hadith describes praiseworthy qualities of an ideal wife in terms of affection, chastity, modesty, and proper conduct within marriage. It presents a Prophetic teaching on family ethics and spousal behavior, emphasizing dignity, obedience within the marital relationship, and moral restraint with others.
